testcase.name: Derivatives agree with central finite differences of the points (independent of the derivative formulas) (section 4)
End derivatives: B'(0) = n (P1 - P0), B'(1) = n (Pn - Pn-1); joining with mirrored handles is C1 (section 4)
Validation: null or non-finite control points and non-finite parameters are IllegalArgumentExceptions (sections 4, 8)
Endpoints are exact for arbitrary control points: point(0) = first, point(1) = last (section 4)
Degree elevation: a line and a quadratic written as higher-degree Beziers give the same points (section 4, metamorphic)
Affine invariance and reversal: Bezier of posed control points = posed Bezier; reversed control points at 1 - t give the same point (section 4)
Degenerate geometry: coincident control points give a constant point and a zero derivative, without exceptions (sections 4, 8)
